```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("SCENARIO_AUDIT")) {
  SCENARIO_AUDIT <- fread(file.path(root, "data", "audit", "summary.csv"))
  SCENARIO_MASTER <- fread(file.path(root, "data", "records", "scenarios", "IMW.csv"))
  SCENARIO_COMPLETE <- unique(SCENARIO_MASTER$ScenarioID)
  if (!nrow(SCENARIO_AUDIT) || !length(SCENARIO_COMPLETE)) stop("scenarios.results.qmd: scenario audit and inventory must be non-empty.")
  if (!setequal(SCENARIO_AUDIT$ScenarioID, SCENARIO_COMPLETE)) stop("scenarios.results.qmd: audit and generated scenario inventory do not match.")
}
```

### Evaluated family

Table @tbl-scenarios-inventory presents the evaluated conditions, the three PPV targets used for scaling, and the number of realizations in each scenario. Each row represents a condition $(d,q,p)$; its realizations are obtained from the source histories in the instrumental population.

{{< include /_tbl/scenarios.qmd >}}

### Numerical verification

Table @tbl-scenario-audit reports the vertical PPV, horizontal rotation, and positive-PGA checks for the generated family, using the acceptance criteria defined in the methodology.

{{< include /_tbl/audit.qmd >}}

### Response spectra

The following panels show the pointwise median of the 5%-damped pseudoacceleration spectra over all realizations of each scenario. Components H1, H2, and UP and the charge levels are presented separately; the curves compare distances within each panel.

{{< include /_fig/scenarios.PSA.qmd >}}
